inputs.text: This looks less like a neutral account of one arrest and more like a coordinated effort to make New York City’s policies the villain. DHS gets to spotlight a gang label and a release, then use the fear around that case to sell stronger immigration enforcement. We’re being handed the version that serves the crackdown, while the people shaping the story avoid scrutiny. The real question is who benefits from turning one incident into a political warning.
